On the downside, a negative FAA finding on the 737 MAX 10 Phase 2 certification — such as a testing failure, new safety directive, or certification delay announcement — could send BA below $200 in a single session. Boeing has a history of 8-12% gap downs on regulatory setbacks.

(3) Broader geopolitical risk: the Trump-Xi summit context means U.S.-China trade relations could shift rapidly, impacting both the China order and general aerospace sector sentiment.
